summary: Practise oil and gas project planning, scheduling, risk and reporting. Explore the five-day course and its practical project-control exercises.
lede: Project management in oil and gas gives coordinators, engineers and site supervisors a structured way to plan and monitor project delivery. This foundation-level course covers defining work packages, linking schedule dependencies, tracking cost and progress, maintaining risk and interface records, and assessing changes. Practical exercises also address earned value concepts, hazard identification, status reporting and handover preparation through project scenarios.
audienceIntro: This foundation course suits professionals who contribute to oil and gas project planning, coordination, controls or site delivery. It is designed for roles that need to turn engineering and field commitments into clear schedules, records and decisions.
prerequisites: No prior oil and gas project management experience is required. Basic familiarity with workplace project documents is helpful; coding or programming is not required.
